rows: Statistics of the most recent solve on this worker process, one row per metric (NULL values until the first solve).

rows.vgi.doc_llm: The statistics of the **most recent solve** handled by this worker process, as `(metric, value)` rows: `status`, `objective`, `best_bound`, `wall_time`, `num_branches`, `num_conflicts`, `num_booleans`, `deterministic_time`. A convenience mirror of the solve metadata; every `value` is NULL until the first solve runs. This is per-process, not strictly per-connection -- the authoritative, race-free source is the metadata columns on each solver's own result rows.
rows.vgi.doc_md:
## last_solve_stats

A browsable table of the most recent solve's metrics, one row per metric: `status`, `objective`, `best_bound`, `wall_time`, `num_branches`, `num_conflicts`, `num_booleans`, `deterministic_time`. Scan it after a solve; every `value` is NULL until the first solve runs. It reflects the last solve on this worker *process*, so for a race-free per-query value prefer the metadata columns on the solver's own result rows.

**Reference:** [OR-Tools documentation](https://developers.google.com/optimization/cp/cp_solver)
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Read every metric of the most recent solve on this worker.", "sql": "SELECT metric, value FROM ortools.main.last_solve_stats ORDER BY metric"}, {"description": "Fetch just the status of the most recent solve.", "sql": "SELECT value FROM ortools.main.last_solve_stats WHERE metric = 'status'"}]
rows.vgi.executable_examples: [{"description": "Run a solve, then read back the statistics of that solve.", "sql": ["SELECT count(*) FROM ortools.main.solve_assignment(cost := [[0,0,1],[1,1,1]]::BIGINT[][], maximize := false)", "SELECT metric, value FROM ortools.main.last_solve_stats ORDER BY metric"]}]
rows.vgi.title: Last Solve Statistics

rows: CREATE TABLE last_solve_stats(metric VARCHAR, "value" VARCHAR, PRIMARY KEY(metric));
Bundled OR-Tools / worker / dialect versions, one row per component (no arguments).

rows.vgi.doc_llm: The bundled solver and worker versions as `(component, version)` rows: `ortools`, `cp_sat`, `glop`, `pdlp`, the `worker` build version, and the `dialect` version of the `solve_cpsat` JSON model. Scan it directly (no arguments) for diagnostics or compatibility checks -- e.g. to confirm which OR-Tools release backs a result before relying on version-specific behaviour.
rows.vgi.doc_md:
## solver_info

A browsable table of the bundled component versions, one row per component: `ortools`, `cp_sat`, `glop`, `pdlp`, the `worker` build version, and the `dialect` version of the `solve_cpsat` JSON model. It takes no arguments -- scan it and filter with `WHERE`.

**Reference:** [OR-Tools documentation](https://developers.google.com/optimization)
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "List every bundled component and its version.", "sql": "SELECT component, version FROM ortools.main.solver_info ORDER BY component"}, {"description": "Fetch just the OR-Tools engine version.", "sql": "SELECT version FROM ortools.main.solver_info WHERE component = 'ortools'"}]
rows.vgi.executable_examples: [{"description": "List the bundled solver and worker versions.", "sql": "SELECT component, version FROM ortools.main.solver_info ORDER BY component"}, {"description": "Look up just the OR-Tools engine version.", "sql": "SELECT version FROM ortools.main.solver_info WHERE component = 'ortools'"}]
rows.vgi.title: Solver Versions

rows: CREATE TABLE solver_info(component VARCHAR, "version" VARCHAR NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(component));
